quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has sharp curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pavement is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield for left turns on green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control sign mean?

options.text: No traffic allowed in this lane.
You must move into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the separated highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead is too narrow to pass or meet a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead is too narrow to pass or meet a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazardous conditions ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A low railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign means the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider will turn right or change lanes to the right. Riders use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal is used when riding in groups. It means "follow me."

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane does not continue through the interchange. The lane leads to an exit ramp. If you are in this lane, you can either move to another lane or exit the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the operator will slow down or stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for yellow lights, red lights, and crossing traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out, it means the operator will turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the operator will turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful because the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals tell other drivers what you plan to do. A left arm extended straight out means the rider will turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way lanes separated by a divider. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross. Drive carefully here because bicycles often cross or ride along the road.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot pass other vehicles in this area. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in this location. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does the speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Hiking trails are to the right.
A hotel is to the right.
A hospital is to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that hospital emergency services are located to the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider holds their left arm out straight with palm up, then swings it upward, it means all riders should go faster.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: When driving on a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the road. If the next lane is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn drivers about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Look for trains before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
This lane is reserved for buses and vehicles with two or more people.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces set aside only for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for a freeway exit.
The safest speed for a freeway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for a freeway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for exiting a freeway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight from this lane.
You can turn left or go straight from this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight from this lane.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One fewer lane; the right lane will end soon.
One fewer lane; the left lane will end soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: One fewer lane; the right lane will end soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot turn right. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road is joining from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a curve in the road is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is joining the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end ahead. Drivers in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights arranged vertically always have red on top and green on bottom. When arranged horizontally, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be prepared to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: A lead rider extends their left arm out with palm down, then swings it down to their side. This tells riders behind them to slow down.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot yield to vehicles, so you must let them pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through it means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when passing through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means an action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of bicycle cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and vehicles are harder to control.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and cross traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before going.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is prohibited. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The highway is under construction or maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway is under construction or maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn of unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign alerts you to a construction zone ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right and shows the safe speed to use (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down at this sign and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will become one lane. Be ready for traffic to merge together.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and give the right-of-way at an intersection. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow (in this case, left). Multiple chevron signs may mark the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that people may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When riding in groups, the lead rider uses hand signals to communicate. This signal tells the group to form a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you there is a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians. Proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a person is directing traffic in a construction area ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a winding road is ahead. Slow down and be ready for many curves. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. You may only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a divided highway is coming. Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, this signals the group to stop.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or going straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to make space so traffic can merge safely.
